system.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to shroud yourself in negative energy until you take Severe damage or the scene ends. Adversaries within Melee that damage you take 1d10 energy damage. Spend a Hope to extend this to Close range. Release: after successfully using this card, flip it to Seal.
